title: Renew long-running video render leases safely
objective: Prevent duplicate long-running video renders by adding owner-checked video-render lease renewal and a bounded heartbeat around renderLocalizedVideo. The heartbeat must start only after a job is claimed, renew at the established worker lease cadence, always stop in finally, never let one worker finish or fail another worker's job, and preserve single-concurrency scheduling and current render acceptance behavior. Add deterministic tests for successful renewal, stale-owner refusal, heartbeat cleanup on success and failure, and no-job behavior. Do not change FFmpeg flags, subtitle decisions, schemas destructively, or production configuration.
